case_number: Civil Appeal No. 11095 of 2018; Civil Appeal Nos. 11910-11911 of 2018; [plus other consolidated appeals listed]
summary: Change in Law relief under power purchase agreements; domestic coal shortfall compensation on 'actuals' vs trigger levels; operating parameters based on actuals or bid specifications; effective date for New Coal Distribution Policy 2013; allowed claims: CVD, excise duty, service tax, royalty, clean energy cess; disallowed claims: deemed export benefit withdrawal, MAT increase, coal handling surcharges; carrying cost relief allowed; appeal allowed in part, APTEL judgment modified.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; APTEL judgment modified; certain disallowed claims restored.
